selected.description: A standalone app and DAW plugin (AAX / VST3 / AU) that emulates classic hardware synthesizers, samplers, and keyboards by running their original firmware on cycle-accurate CPU and DSP emulators.
selected.content_summary: Matrix-1000 CEM3396 voice model implements four-sample BLEP/BLAMP corrections and a separate 2x halfband decimator; bundled SFZero/wxWidgets files are not counted as project hardware.
selected.portability_summary: Port only the oscillator correction and decimator subset; the full firmware/CPU emulator is not qualified for Cortex-M7. Build, CPU and memory checks remain NOT_RUN.
selected.reuse_idea: Implement the four-sample BLEP/BLAMP reset in a small Daisy/Teensy oscillator and compare hard-sync aliasing before adopting 2x oversampling.

repeat_update_evidence.summary: Re-entry after September 22: the new Matrix-1000 core and BLEP/BLAMP/2x decimation are substantive synthesis additions, not just a fresh push.

selected.description: Samplotron is an ESP32 hardware sampler for musicians and producers: play WAVs from SD, map samples to MIDI notes, tweak per-sample volume and shot/loop mode, and save live-ready setups on device.
selected.content_summary: The ESP32 sampler voice engine implements gain/fade/voice lifecycle; audio.h exposes a separate SD reader task and streaming-underrun diagnostics.
selected.portability_summary: Reuse the SD reader/audio task split and per-sample voice fades; replace Arduino, SD and I2S interfaces for Daisy or Teensy. Target performance remains NOT_RUN.
selected.reuse_idea: Give SD reads a separate task, preload sample starts into RAM, and log underruns and maximum read latency before increasing polyphony.

repeat_update_evidence.summary: Repeat after September 15: merged SD-streaming underrun fixes change practical sampler reuse; the pinned source exposes reader-task separation and diagnostics.

selected.description: SSI2130 analog VCO with waveform mixer, suboscillator and sync/FM inputs; published schematic and BOM, with no editable EDA source in the inspected revision.
selected.content_summary: The one-page circuit identifies SSI2130 U11, sync/FM conditioning and waveform mixing; an interactive BOM provides component/placement data. Editable EDA files are absent.
selected.portability_summary: Useful as an analog oscillator/control reference beside Daisy/Teensy, not as DSP firmware; reconstructing/editing the circuit and bench qualification remain required.
selected.reuse_idea: Study the through-zero FM/sync and waveform-mixer circuitry for a hybrid voice; validate control scaling, headroom and tracking on a separate prototype.

selected.description: ESP32-S3 firmware that turns a $20 dev-board into a 2-in / 4-out audio DSP. UAC-class audio + browser-controlled PEQ / crossover / room EQ. Active 2-way speakers, embarrassingly cheap.
selected.content_summary: The C processing pipeline has static biquad state, PEQ/crossover/routing stages and bounded delay buffers; ESP-IDF build files and packaging tests are present.
selected.portability_summary: The static C filter/routing pipeline is a concrete Cortex-M7 adaptation candidate; replace ESP-IDF attributes and USB/I2S glue. Firmware builds remain NOT_RUN.
selected.reuse_idea: Port the PEQ/crossover chain first, retain its negated-a coefficient convention, then add coefficient-update and gain/routing regression vectors.

selected.description: Dual-SSI2130 analog monosynth with ADSR/LFO, gate/CV inputs and swappable filter; complete editable main-board and panel assets.
selected.content_summary: Editable KiCad sheets and populated PCB include two SSI2130 VCOs; the repository also contains ADSR/LFO/gate/mixer sheets, BOMs and fabrication files.
selected.portability_summary: A full analog signal-path and enclosure/control reference, rather than portable DSP code; Daisy/Teensy would provide external control or processing and require analog-interface design.
selected.reuse_idea: Adapt the dual-VCO sync/PWM and gate/CV interfaces for a digitally controlled analog voice; retain the swappable-filter interface for experiments.
selected.related_project_note: Related to the daily September 21 SSI2130 core, but a different integrated design: two VCOs plus ADSR/LFO, gate/CV, panel and swappable VCF integration.

selected.description: Open-source audio plugins: Weft spectral filter, Wow pitch modulation and Inton microtuning. CLAP and VST3 for macOS, Windows and Linux.
selected.content_summary: Rust fractional-delay code implements cubic/eight-point Farrow, Lagrange and sinc interpolation; tests cover integer positions, kernel equivalence and DC/ring-wrap behavior.
selected.portability_summary: Start with the bounded f32/Farrow subset; full-quality paths use tables, heap-backed storage and f64. C++ or no-std adaptation and MCU profiling remain NOT_RUN.
selected.reuse_idea: Translate a four-tap Farrow reader into a preallocated delay ring and preserve the integer-position/DC tests as desktop regression vectors.

selected.content_summary: A scalar Hermite soft-knee saturator and eight-line FDN tank expose sample/block processing; the tank includes interpolation, modulation and damping.
selected.portability_summary: The saturator is a small scalar port; an FDN port must bound delay memory and profile its modulation/interpolation. No host or target build was run for this digest.
selected.reuse_idea: Reuse the saturator as a feedback limiter, then port a reduced FDN configuration with explicit SDRAM/delay-size and decay-stability tests.

selected.description: An experimental multi-timbal MIDI Synthesizer that uses 3HS88PWN4 to make sound.
selected.content_summary: The synth core integrates scalar biquad filtering and a stereo three-band EQ with a slew-limited envelope; filter provenance is attributed to UtsBox in the source.
selected.portability_summary: Extract the scalar filter/envelope only; the effect wrapper copies and allocates vectors and fixes slew timing to 48 kHz. Replace those buffers and rate constants before Cortex-M7 profiling; builds remain NOT_RUN.
selected.reuse_idea: Convert the three-band EQ to preallocated channel buffers and pass sample rate into the envelope, preserving filter-provenance attribution and coefficient regression vectors.

selected.description: Modular audio effects workstation — 30+ DSP effects, node graph, CLAP plugin, Daisy hardware export
selected.content_summary: The Rust biquad uses explicit TDF-II state; a no_std Daisy reverb example, STM32 configuration, memory.x and other audio/bring-up examples are present.
selected.portability_summary: Source already includes a Daisy target and audio examples; inspect allocator/SDRAM requirements per effect. That source evidence does not establish a successful build or hardware run.
selected.reuse_idea: Compare the existing Daisy single-effect callback, memory map and controls with your firmware before adapting one no_std effect kernel.

selected.description: akróasys: a JUCE-based deconstructive synthesizer that repurposes generative AI as an oscillator.
selected.content_summary: The DSP folder contains actual ADSR state/update code and a separate algorithmic reverb implementation, alongside the larger desktop/AI instrument.
selected.portability_summary: Reuse only the envelope/reverb subset; the generative-AI oscillator and complete JUCE application have not been qualified for Daisy/Teensy.
selected.reuse_idea: Extract ADSR timing and parameter smoothing into an allocation-free voice envelope, with sample-rate and retrigger tests before a hardware port.

selection_notes.SSI2130: Polymorph and Micro-Pico selected; JordanAceto/SSI2130_VCO held by daily September 21 publication. aesuf evaluation/MIDI capture held for unfinished integration (28 unannotated MIDI schematic references).
selection_notes.SSI2131: Four repository results; none outranks the final cutoff on the fixed score formula; FAREKIND remains a circuit-source recheck lead.
selection_notes.SSI2140: Micro-Ox filter/VCA source and the phase shifter were inspected; both are held because they are already in the shared starred watchlist.
selection_notes.SSI2144: One zero-star/zero-fork repository result; below final cutoff, not source-promoted.
selection_notes.SSI2164: Micro-Ox SSI2164 VCA circuitry was inspected but is starred and held. Six bare-query results score below the cutoff or are starred; previously featured DualVCA lacks new activity inside its window.
selection_notes.SSI2190: No results in the bare SSI2190 repository search; the original SSI2190+delay query was also executed. Code-only or off-GitHub projects remain outside this search evidence.
